groups.label: Start here
groups.description: Today, the bare honest camera, and the calmest full treatment.

groups.label: All treatments
groups.description: Switch at the same moment. Today is the real shipped film; the rest are drawn by the lab.

groups.label: Hit energy
groups.description: Today against the three most energetic treatments.

groups.label: Other songs
groups.description: The camera on songs it was not tuned on (No Batidão, Let the World Burn, Montagem Coma). Pick one of those songs below.

passages.label: Petrunko
passages.description: Full song, 1080 × 1920, 60 fps, with its music.

videos.label: Today (shipped)
videos.description: The real production film: today’s camera, rainbow bars, shake, colour split and flash.

videos.label: Ride
videos.description: The honest camera, a little wider than round 1, pencil to ink. Nothing else: the baseline.

videos.label: Graphite
videos.description: The camera breathes with the music; the ink presses at each hit with a small kick; tuning fork; whole-course opening and ending.

videos.label: Today, refined
videos.description: Today’s spirit with a direction: kick into the line, split along the impact, flash. Director camera; three-colour bars.

videos.label: Night voltage
videos.description: The drop turns to night. Trailing split and a line slice on hits; Iris; director camera.

videos.label: Porcelain
videos.description: Section colours; zoom pulse and ink pressure on hits; blocks; builds through each section, releases on the downbeat.

videos.label: Weight
videos.description: Letterbox bars punch in with each blow, a slight roll, a kick; mirrored fork; section tones; frames every jump.

videos.label: One red
videos.description: Monochrome plus the scarf’s red. Band and accents drop out in quiet sections; the landing spot pre-inks; two locked-off shots.
